main: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original isolated production illustration for DeCocoa's chocolate-history website: a beautifully composed cacao botanical still-life group, with one ripe golden-rust cacao pod, one lengthwise opened cacao pod showing cream-white pulp around seeds, and a graceful small woody branch with deep olive-green cacao leaves behind the pods. This is one logical independently positionable botanical group, not a page or a poster. Warm museum-quality natural illustration with painterly tactile detail, softly modeled rich chocolate-brown shadows (#3A170D and #170905), warm cream highlights (#F7EFE6), restrained rusty orange and Leaf green (#327D4F). Detailed but clearly illustrated, refined botanical realism, cohesive soft upper-left light. Slightly elevated three-quarter view, grounded balanced silhouette, square canvas, generous but not excessive transparent margin, complete unclipped leaf and pod edges. Pods large and dominant, leaves airy. True alpha transparent background, including spaces between leaves. No background scene, no solid rectangle, no ground plane, no baked checkerboard, no paper texture outside the object, no text, lettering, dates, caption, border, logo, human figures, cultural costume, bowl, loose dry beans, chocolate bars or modern packaging. Intended to sit directly on either cream or dark brown web backgrounds. Aim for 1024 by 1024 resolution.
